newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine official to visit Japan to discuss trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine official to visit Japan to discuss trade.

text.p: Argentina's economic relations secretary, Jorge Campbell, is to travel to Japan on Saturday to discuss trade and investment between the two countries, state news agency Telam reported Wednesday.
The trip comes on the back of increased interest expressed by Japanese companies in the Mercosur customs union which groups Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.
The secretary will meet with Japan's vice foreign minister and other government officials on his trip.
